items.html: But the souls of the righteous — and a general soul is from Beria, and there are souls higher than that, which are from Atzilut, as is known; however, the smallest in level are from Beria, and Beria is in the secret of GAR, which are the Mochin. Therefore the upper Malchut needs to become pregnant with the souls of the righteous, whose root is from Beria, the place of the Mochin; and then she can ascend by their means upward into AVI, and take the Mochin fit for her. And this is the secret of the reason for the raising of MAN through the lower souls. And understand this.
